item.title: Binary Representation: Signed vs Unsigned
item.description: In this post, we explore difference between signed and unsigned integer with binary representation within computer systems. Signed integers can represent positive number, zero, and negative number while unsigned integer can represent only positive numbers. There are three primary methods to represent signed binary numbers, wiht two’s complement being the most widely used method in modern systems.
